title: Garden-Audit Wire
description: Complete mirror of the garden-audit review surface (ADR-4 / ADR-026). Emitted alongside the markdown report by garden-audit-render.py; consumed by garden-audit-parser.py in Pass-2 to rebuild confirmed fixes from JSON alone. emit_digest is the change signal: when it no longer matches a recomputation over the editable payload (findings[].decision fields, with emit_digest absent), Pass-2 rebuilds from this JSON. Both artifacts are projected from the same garden-audit-doc.json (no drift by construction).

schema_version.description: Schema version — always '1' for this iteration.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this wire was produced.

run_id.description: Stable run identifier joining the report and wire.

emit_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical editable payload (this object with emit_digest absent). Recomputed and compared in Pass-2 to detect user edits.

findings.description: All findings, severity-ordered (integrity → structure → advisory). Each fixable finding carries a 'decision' block the user can edit; advisory findings omit 'decision'.

id.description: Stable finding identifier (e.g. F01). Joins the markdown report to the wire.

fixable.description: True for checks 1-4 (unparented,orphan,broken_up,dead_link). False for advisory checks 5-6.

target.description: The primary note this finding targets.

detail.description: Per-check detail. Fields vary by check type (read-only in the wire).

candidate_mocs.description: unparented/orphan: scored MOC candidates from orphan_link.

up_target.description: broken_up: the broken up:: target stem.

dead_target.description: dead_link: the unresolved wikilink target text.

count.description: dead_link: how many times the dead link appears.

dupes.description: duplicate_stem: list of paths sharing the stem.

mtime.description: stale_moc: last-modified ISO timestamp from listDir.

decision.description: Editable block — present ONLY on fixable findings (fixable=true). Absent for advisory. The user edits 'selected' to accept or skip the fix; Pass-2 reads this field alone.

selected.description: Editable — true to apply the fix. Pre-set from finding.decision.selected in the doc.

action.description: Proposed action name (e.g. link_to_moc, edit_note_text, add_relationship). Null when not yet determined.

replace.description: dead_link only — editable replacement target (e.g. '[[New Note]]'). Empty string = remove intent. Absent on all other check types.

repoint.description: broken_up only — editable repoint target (e.g. '[[Correct MOC]]'). Non-empty repoints up:: to the chosen MOC (add_relationship); empty string = remove the broken line. Absent on all other check types.
